The applying login must reach both relations as the function's owner past RLS (definer_can_write_relations: the table owner without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or a superuser or BYPASSRLS): a DEFINER insert filtered by RLS would be refused exactly as the API's insert is today. Expected pre-state in both environments: the function absent (release sql145 v1 / function public.aws_platform_owner_insert_billing_collection_leg(uuid, text, text, text, bigint, text, text, uuid, text, text, text, text, jsonb): absent). Where it already exists (a re-run) it must be owned by the applying login (functions_owned_by_login), keep its public.payment_transfers result (function_results_match) and hold no EXECUTE grant other than checksops and the owner, which the file keeps, and PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role, which it revokes (function_acl_replaceable). The ACL after the apply is checksops and the owner. The API change that calls the function (aws/functions/api/tenant-collection-v2.mjs, savepoint collection_insert_leg) needs the guarded Lambda path after this pin is applied in that environment; until then (and if the API is deployed first) a platform-owner collection leg fails to save exactly as today (logged, rolled back to its savepoint, obligation submitted with leg_persist_failed). No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.
